project_title: AutoPlot Lab - Sistem Plotting Absensi & Roster Otomatis Anggota Laboratorium

theme_strategy.rationale: High-density shift plotting matrices, OCR document side-by-side inspections, and schedule grid heatmaps require contrast and low eye fatigue for lab managers working long hours.

brand_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST with Precision Lab aesthetics
brand_identity.tagline: Ekstraksi PDF/Screenshot Bebas Bentrok, Plot Roster Lab Otomatis Sesuai Divisi

backend.ocr_processing: Tesseract OCR / EasyOCR / PyMuPDF (fitz) for PDF textual parsing + OpenCV for screenshot schedule table boundary detection
backend.schedule_parser: Custom Regex & Parsing Engine recognizing KODENAMA_DIVISI format (e.g. AHL_FRONTEND.pdf, NFN_BACKEND.png) and mapping weekly day/time blocks
backend.plotting_engine: Constraint Satisfaction Solver (OR-Tools / Greedy Slot Allocation Algorithm) ensuring (1) zero class schedule collision, (2) all divisions represented per active lab day, (3) equitable shift balance across members
backend.spreadsheet_exporter: OpenPyXL / Pandas multi-sheet generator creating 'Sheet 1: Plotting Utama Roster' and 'Sheet 2: Validasi & Error Log'

frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + Custom Design Tokens
frontend.component_library: Shadcn UI (Customized with sharp edges, high contrast, non-generic cards)
frontend.state_management: React Query (TanStack Query) + Context for active session & roster state

font_families.mono_data: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

main_app_views.title: 1. Upload File & Ekstraksi OCR
main_app_views.description: Drop multiple file PDF/PNG/JPG dengan penamaan format (KODENAMA_DIVISI), misal AHL_FRONTEND.pdf. Sistem otomatis mengurai jadwal kuliah.

main_app_views.title: 2. Review & Koreksi Jadwal
main_app_views.description: Inspeksi tabel manual dengan highlight slot sibuk (kuliah) vs slot kosong. Terdapat tombol edit langsung sebelum masuk solver.

main_app_views.title: 3. Engine Parameters & Rules
main_app_views.description: Atur durasi shift lab (misal 2 jam/shift), kuota shift min/maks per divisi, dan pastikan rule 'Minimal 1 anggota tiap divisi per hari'.

main_app_views.title: 4. Matrix Visual Matrix Plotting
main_app_views.description: Grid interaktif Senin-Sabtu (07.00 - 18.00) dengan filter per divisi, per jam, per anggota, beserta status validasi coverage.

main_app_views.title: 5. Ekspor Spreadsheet & Validation Sheet
main_app_views.description: Unduh file .xlsx resmi dengan Sheet 1 (Plotingan Utama) & Sheet 2 (Laporan Constraint & Validasi Error).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENT RECOGNITION OF FILE NAMING PATTERN (KODENAMA_DIVISI): Parse filenames matching regex like `([A-Z0-9]+)_([A-Z0-9_]+)\.(pdf|png|jpg|jpeg)` automatically when uploaded, populating member code and division.

2. BUILD OCR & SCHEDULE REVIEW SCREEN: Allow users to preview uploaded document image/PDF, view OCR extracted weekly class schedules (Senin-Sabtu), toggle status (Kuliah vs Kosong), edit course names, and confirm.

3. IMPLEMENT AUTOMATIC PLOTTING ALGORITHM: Plot lab shifts only during empty/free slots between classes. Enforce Rule: Every operating day MUST have at least one member from EVERY registered division.

4. INTERACTIVE MATRIX & PREVIEW ENGINE: Provide daily timeline view (07:00-18:00), division coverage indicator widgets (e.g. Frontend: 3 slots covered, Backend: 2 slots covered), conflict detection alerts, and manual drag/slot swap support.

5. DUAL-SHEET EXCEL/SPREADSHEET EXPORT: Generate Excel downloads with two tabs: Sheet 1 (Plotingan Utama Roster Absensi per Jam & Hari) and Sheet 2 (Sheet Validasi Coverage Divisi, Jam Kosong Unassigned, dan Error Log).

6. ADD PRELOADED SAMPLE DATA: Provide pre-filled sample files and batch uploads (e.g., AHL_FRONTEND, NFN_BACKEND, RZK_UIUX, DNI_HARDWARE, KVN_DEVOPS, BLK_DATAAI) for instant one-click demonstration of the auto-plotting engine.
7. ENSURE CRITICAL TESTIDS: Add data-testid to key buttons, dropzone, table cells, review forms, solver triggers, and spreadsheet download buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Always set explicit hover text color (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Never use plain transparent background for headers, dialogs, or floating popovers; use dark blurred crystal backdrop (bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md).
Add data-testid in kebab-case to all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='upload-dropzone-input', data-testid='run-autoplot-button', data-testid='export-excel-button').
Keep typography scalable and capped at text-5xl for headers.
Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font for codes (KODENAMA), shift time slots (08:00-10:00), and validation logs.
